exposure.needed: whether monitoring dashboards, alerts or queries consume the envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_duration metric

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_duration` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_duration`.

decision.reason: [ev-3fa40f2e19e8] and the section lead-in [ev-77f05428497a] only say that the Envoy NPDS metric prefix changed, so this metric is now exported as envoy_cilium_npds_update_duration. They name no Helm value, flag, field or ConfigMap key that would decide exposure. An environment is exposed only if its dashboards, alerts or queries use the old metric name, and the product configuration doesn't show that. So the proposed undecidable leaf, which states what is needed, expresses the exposure correctly.
